title: In development
summary: Built candidates and open testing, clearly separated from live features.
body:
Adventure Journal & Epic 0.5

The eight journal quests and Wayfarer’s Oath charm have been built but are not installed on the server. The candidate uses three shared chapters followed by Guardian, Striker, Arcanist, Warden or Binder paths. These are not available rewards.

Combat and item candidates

Monk and Beastlord fist, skill-progression and some existing tiered item corrections have a tested candidate but no recorded deployment. A frozen personal casting bar remains under investigation.

Ongoing gameplay checks

Multiclass equipment, extra-class trainers, dual wield, stats, regeneration, ability names and Bard movement/songs still need checks or fixes. Installed features also need player acceptance across builds and progression stages.
